name: AllMovieLand
description: AllMovieLand streaming provider with multi-language support. TMDB catalog (trending, search, seasons & episodes) + the site's own stream resolver (player domain -> p3 token -> playlist POST -> m3u8). Ported from Hindi-Nuvio.

name: Goated
description: Free movies & TV shows (up to 4K) from goated.cx. TMDB catalog (trending, popular, search, full details, seasons & episodes) plus the site's own stream resolver (proof-of-work + AES-256-GCM -> merged video+audio HLS). Fully on-device: no server, no ffmpeg, no yt-dlp. Auto-detects Orbit & Valenox, verifies each server before listing it, and filters dead ones so only working servers show.
